archetypes.name: dyn-exec-detail-parser
archetypes.rationale: The new shared parser preserves legacy fence and NDJSON fallback semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/exec_issue_detail.py for parity with prior final_report issue counts. Focus on markdown section boundaries, fenced bullets, malformed NDJSON, degraded string-count totals, and duplicate collapse. Check that count_load_result remains the single source for header totals. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-summary-splice
archetypes.rationale: Both final summary paths now splice a new rendered block before review detail.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/design_summary.py and python/final_report.py integration points. Verify pre-phase design summaries only pass counts, post summaries append exec/warning detail before review phase detail, and tracking/upsert/stdout bodies stay consistent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-assessment-safety
archetypes.rationale: Assessment prompts call an external CLI with issue text and must fail closed without leaking secrets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review assessment prompt construction and rendering redaction in exec_issue_detail. Confirm only redacted display_text/count values go to Claude, envelope failures omit assessments, and rendered blocks redact suffixes without exposing fenced diagnostics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
